name: Suzuki Boulevard M109R
engine: 1783 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Suzuki's big power cruiser. Mostly routine work, plus one accessory recall to check.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. If the bike has a Suzuki accessory backrest, check that recall 15E053 was done. Some backrest kits came with bolts of the wrong length.
A-002.reason: Wrong-length bolts can let the backrest come loose.

recalls.what: Backrest mounting kit may have the wrong-length bolts.
